description: CYS401 final roadmap: how the ten chapters fit together, from security foundations and threats to cryptography, secure systems and access control, with the material to study for each topic, look-alike concepts side by side and a coverage tracker.
lede: CYS401 builds up in layers: first what we protect and from whom, then how to find and rank threats, how cryptography protects data, how systems are designed to resist attack, and finally who may get in. Each level relies on the one above it.

ca2: Class Activity 2: spear phishing and keylogger

confusables.title: Hash vs MAC vs digital signature
confusables.ask: Is there a key, and could the sender deny it?
test: Which mechanism lets a receiver prove to a judge who sent the message?

confusables.title: Encrypt vs sign: which key?
confusables.ask: Do you want secrecy or proof of the sender?
rows: Receiver's public key; receiver decrypts with their private key
Sender's private key; anyone verifies with the sender's public key

confusables.title: Bell-LaPadula vs Biba
confusables.ask: Is the goal confidentiality or integrity?
rows: Confidentiality: no read up, no write down
Integrity: no read down, no write up
test: A model stops low-integrity data from contaminating trusted records. Which?

confusables.title: DAC vs MAC vs RBAC vs rule-based
rows: The system, by labels and clearances
test: Users on a peer-to-peer network set their own folder permissions. Which model?

confusables.title: Due care vs due diligence
confusables.ask: Doing the protective thing, or checking that it keeps working?
test: Auditing a vendor's security before signing. Which?

confusables.title: Governance vs management
confusables.ask: Right things, or things done right?
rows: Tactical execution by the CISO and teams
test: The board approves the security strategy. Governance or management?

confusables.title: Confinement vs process isolation vs bounds
confusables.ask: Where can it write, can it touch others, or how much power does it have?
rows: Own memory space; cannot affect others
test: A process may only write to certain memory locations. Which?

confusables.title: FRR vs FAR vs CER
confusables.ask: Was a genuine user rejected, an impostor accepted, or are you comparing devices?
test: Which error should a bank vault scanner minimize?

confusables.title: IT vs OT priorities
confusables.ask: Is the system processing data or running a physical process?
rows: Availability and safety first, rare patching
test: In SCADA, which CIA property comes first?
